import pathlib,tomllib
d=tomllib.loads(pathlib.Path(r'research/nima/contracts/typed-response.v1.toml').read_text())
T,U,Y,F=d['tables'],d['unions'],d['types'],d['field_sets']
assert set(d['root']['required'])==set(d['root']['allowed'])
for n,t in T.items():
 r,a=set(t.get('required',[])),set(t.get('allowed',[]))
 assert r<=a and len(r)==len(t.get('required',[])) and len(a)==len(t.get('allowed',[])),n
 fs=F.get(t.get('field_set',''),{})
 typed=set(t.get('fields',{}))|set(t.get('constants',{}))|set(fs)
 assert a<=typed,(n,'untyped',a-typed)
 for s in t.get('fields',{}).values():
  if 'schema_ref'in s: assert s['schema_ref'] in T
  if 'item_schema_ref'in s: assert s['item_schema_ref'] in T or s['item_schema_ref'] in U
 for k in t.get('constants',{}): assert k in r
for n,u in U.items():
 assert u['discriminator']=='kind' and len(u['variants'])==len(set(u['variants']))
 for v in u['variants']: assert v in T and T[v]['constants']['kind']
for fs in F.values():
 for typ in fs.values(): assert typ in Y
ids=[x['id'] for x in d['constraints']]
assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
assert T['changed_file']['required']==['path','operation']
assert 'communication' in T['agent']['required']
assert Y['evidence_array']['min_items']==1
assert 'has_attention' not in str(d) and 'has_context' not in str(d)
print('structure-pass',len(T),len(U),len(Y),len(ids))
